subject.title: Feature Request: Configurable Session Lane Concurrency + Auto-Yield

question: Should OpenClaw add core session-lane concurrency and auto-yield configuration now, and what ordering, cancellation, transcript-safety, and tool-side-effect contract should those knobs enforce?
rationale: Source inspection proves the requested behavior is missing, but these knobs change core session scheduling and public config, so automation cannot safely choose the product contract.

options.title: Design scheduler contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define concurrency, auto-yield, ordering, cancellation, and transcript-safety semantics, while handling diagnostics separately.

options.title: Ship diagnostics only now
options.body: Use or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86676 for the lane-wait warning threshold and explicitly defer concurrency and auto-yield.

options.title: Reject new core knobs
options.body: Close the direction in favor of existing queue steering, interrupt mode, subagent delegation, and explicit sessions_yield behavior.

recommendation.title: Design scheduler contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define concurrency, auto-yield, ordering, cancellation, and transcript-safety semantics, while handling diagnostics separately.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current and historical signal across command queue, embedded run lane admission, and gateway lane concurrency files.
